クリアピンク、クリアブルーの２色が付属し、お好みに合わせたシーン再現が可能。（※ジョイントは選択式）

en: --- Wings of light expressed in "Ver. Ka". It appears now ---
MG V2 Gundam “Ver.Ka” is now available with an extended effect unit that can reproduce the scene in which the wings of light are deployed in the movie!
*This product does not include the MS body.
Joint with "MG 1/100 V2GundamVer.Ka" (201512 Store Release Scheduled *Sold separately),
Commercialize effects and a special base as an extended effects unit to reproduce the scene in which the "Wings of Light" occurs in the play.
The effect comes in two colors, clear pink and clear blue, which can be selected according to your preference.
A special pearl white base with a limited edition feel is included.
・ High-detail, two-color extended effect “Wings of Light”!
Effects perfectly coordinated with the MG V2 Gundam “Ver.Ka” main body form.
The size, mold line, shape, and color were supervised by Hajime Katoki, which carefully calculated the balance with the main body.
Comes in two colors, clear pink and clear blue, allowing you to recreate the scene to your liking. (*Joints are selectable)
・Comes with a special limited edition pearl white base!
For more detailed product information, please check the special feature page (PC version)♪
[Set contents]
● Extended effect ‘Wings of Light’ Clear Pink (1 each for left and right)
● Extended effect ‘Wings of Light’ Clear Blue (1 each for left and right)
● Exclusive base (pearl white)
This product is jointed with "MG 1/100 V2 Gundam Ver.Ka" (sold separately) of 201512 Store Release Scheduled,
A set of ``effect parts and a special base'' to reproduce the scene where the ``Wings of Light'' occurs in the play.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the posted photo, this product and "MG 1/100 V2GundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) are required.
Also, "MG 1/100 V2 GundamVer.Ka" (sold separately) is not available for sale at Premium Bandai.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: PS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
《MG 1/100 V2 GundamVer.Ka is not included in this product》
